title: Editing or Deleting a Threat Intelligence Decoy Personality

blocks.text: You can edit or delete Threat Intelligence (TI) decoy personalities that you configured in the Zscaler Deception Admin Portal.

blocks.heading: Editing a Threat Intelligence Decoy Personality

blocks.text: To edit a TI decoy personality:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Strategy Builder > Threat Intelligence Decoy.
Under Actions, click the Edit icon for the decoy personality you want to modify.
In the Decoy Details window, modify the required fields.

blocks.text: The default TI decoy personalities cannot be edited.

blocks.heading: Deleting a Threat Intelligence Decoy Personality

blocks.text: To delete a TI decoy personality:

blocks.item: Go to Miragemaker > Strategy Builder > Threat Intelligence Decoy.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon for the decoy personality you want to delete.
In the confirmation window, click OK.

blocks.text: The default TI decoy personalities cannot be deleted.
